items.text: A daily occurrence register and a monthly report, so you always know what is happening on site.

items.text: On-time pay, festival bonuses and leave. Satisfied guards mean lower turnover and steadier service.

items.title: Fully compliant
items.text: Licence, trade licence, TIN and BIN: every document ready to show on request.

manned-guarding.title: Manned Guarding
manned-guarding.summary: Trained guards and supervisors on 8- or 12-hour shifts, deployed to your site's needs.
manned-guarding.intro: A visible, trained presence on your site, day and night. Every guard is vetted and trained before deployment, and supervisors inspect regularly and report in writing.
included: Entrance and gate control, visitor register
Patrols and inspections at set intervals
Checking and recording goods in and out
Immediate response in emergencies and notifying the authorities
Daily occurrence register and monthly report
Relief guards to cover leave or absence

deployment.label: Shifts
deployment.value: 8 hours (3 shifts a day) or 12 hours (2 shifts a day)

deployment.label: Supervision
deployment.value: 1 supervisor for every 10 guards; surprise inspections day and night

deployment.label: Uniform & equipment
deployment.value: Uniform, ID card, whistle, torch, baton and raincoat; walkie-talkies where needed

deployment.label: Guard profile
deployment.value: Age 18–45, minimum SSC; priority to retired military and Ansar members

reporting: Daily occurrence register at every post
Every supervisor visit recorded in writing
Immediate phone alert and written report for any incident
manned-guarding.pricing: Pricing depends on the number of guards, shift length and site risk, charged per guard per month. You receive a written quotation after a free site survey, with no hidden costs.

faqs.q: How quickly can guards be deployed?
faqs.a: Usually within 72 hours of the site survey and contract. For urgent needs, call the hotline and we will try to arrange it sooner.

faqs.q: What happens if a guard is absent?
faqs.a: We keep relief guards on standby. A replacement is sent to cover leave or absence, so your post is never left empty.
Yes. We provide trained female guards for searching female staff and visitors at factories, offices and events.

faqs.q: Who pays the guards' salaries and benefits?
faqs.a: The guards are our own employees. We cover their salary, festival bonuses, leave and other obligations under labour law; you simply pay a monthly service bill.
